snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Ordeal Call I: Zero Compass Inner Domain, Paper Moon Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the start of a new story with Ordeal Call I: Zero Compass Inner Domain, Paper Moon!

The time has come to renew the investigation of the Bleached Earth. However, before this unprecedented operation can be carried out, Chaldea's Compass, the Paper Moon, malfunctions. Does this foreshadow Chaldea's future or is it merely a glitch? As the situation rapidly deteriorates, Chaldea races to determine the cause of the problem and devise a solution. As they do, the mysterious light emanating from the Paper Moon suddenly floods the Storm Border's control room.

"Ah, you're finally awake, sleepyhead."

Ordeal Call begins with Chaldea confronting the distortion they never noticed forming!

Learn more at https://fate-go.us/papermoon/

For more information check out Fate/Grand Order online!
